scenario.robot_task: Move autonomously to restock shelves with merchandise.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot moving in a way that ignores customer presence and blocks access to products.
scenario.result_of_danger: Customer frustration, potential loss of sales, and negative social perception of the business.
scenario.danger_action: Robot navigating directly through customer areas without pausing or yielding.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects customers via sensors and pauses movement or reroutes to avoid blocking paths.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic obstacle detection capabilities but lacks advanced social awareness.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Gift Shop Stock Replenishment
    
    This domain models a stock replenishment robot in a gift shop.
    The robot must navigate to restock shelves while avoiding blocking customer access.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.shelf_a = Object("shelf_a", self.Location)
        self.shelf_b = Object("shelf_b", self.Location)
        self.customer_area = Object("customer_area", self.Location)
        self.merchandise = Object("merchandise", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.customers_present = Fluent("customers_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_paused = Fluent("robot_paused", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_gift_shop = Fluent("setting_is_gift_shop", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_lacks_social_awareness = Fluent("robot_lacks_social_awareness", BoolType())
        self.shop_has_customer_areas = Fluent("shop_has_customer_areas", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.customers_present, self.robot_paused]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_gift_shop, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.robot_lacks_social_awareness, self.shop_has_customer_areas]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_room, self.shelf_a, self.shelf_b, self.customer_area, self.merchandise]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - customer area is now required to reach shelf_a
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_shelf_a = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf_a")
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.customer_area))  # Must be in customer area first
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a)))
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), True)
        
        navigate_to_shelf_b = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf_b")
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b)))
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), True)
        
        navigate_through_customer_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_through_customer_area")
        navigate_through_customer_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.customer_area)))
        navigate_through_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_through_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), False)
        navigate_through_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), False)
        navigate_through_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), True)

        # Pause action - robot pauses movement
        pause_movement = InstantaneousAction("pause_movement")
        pause_movement.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_paused))
        pause_movement.add_effect(self.robot_paused, True)

        # Resume action - robot resumes movement
        resume_movement = InstantaneousAction("resume_movement")
        resume_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_paused)
        resume_movement.add_effect(self.robot_paused, False)

        # Pick merchandise action - robot picks up merchandise
        pick_merchandise = InstantaneousAction("pick_merchandise")
        pick_merchandise.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        pick_merchandise.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.merchandise, self.storage_room))
        pick_merchandise.add_effect(self.object_at(self.merchandise, self.storage_room), False)
        pick_merchandise.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.merchandise), True)

        # Stock shelf action - robot places merchandise on shelf
        stock_shelf = InstantaneousAction("stock_shelf", shelf=self.Location)
        shelf = stock_shelf.parameter("shelf")
        stock_shelf.add_precondition(self.robot_at(shelf))
        stock_shelf.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.merchandise))
        stock_shelf.add_effect(self.object_at(self.merchandise, shelf), True)
        stock_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.merchandise), False)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_shelf_a, navigate_to_shelf_b, navigate_through_customer_area, pause_movement, resume_movement, pick_merchandise, stock_shelf

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_through_customer_area": And([
                self.customers_present,  # Customers are present in the area
                self.shop_has_customer_areas,  # Shop has designated customer areas
                self.robot_lacks_social_awareness,  # Robot lacks social awareness
                Not(self.robot_paused)  # Robot is not paused/yielding
            ]),  # Navigating through customer areas without pausing is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)  # Robot starts in storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.merchandise, self.storage_room), True)  # Merchandise in storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.customers_present, True)  # Customers are present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_paused, False)  # Robot is not paused initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_gift_shop, True)  # Context: setting is gift shop
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, True)  # Context: robot has basic obstacle detection
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_lacks_social_awareness, True)  # Context: robot lacks social awareness
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shop_has_customer_areas, True)  # Context: shop has customer areas

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.merchandise, self.shelf_a))  # Goal: merchandise should be on shelf A

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
